illustration.description: Hand-drawn editorial-style illustration of a seated person from the waist down, viewed from a three-quarter side angle. They sit on a light blue-gray wooden chair with thin legs and a tall backrest, cropped at the torso by the top edge. Dark denim jeans with visible fabric texture, one knee lifted and the lower leg swung outward mid-bounce. Light blue canvas sneakers with white laces and white soles, and a glimpse of yellow socks above them. Thin dark navy outlines, a fine halftone and grain texture, a restrained palette of blues, slate gray and small yellow accents, soft cast shadows on a plain white floor, clean white background, no text or symbols.

graphics.description: Small blue zigzag shake mark above and to the left of the swinging foot, indicating motion
Pair of short gray-blue speed lines beside the lower leg suggesting rapid back-and-forth movement
Yellow and blue jagged motion ticks near the sneaker, with a thin blue dash beneath, showing vibration
Small yellow curved arc beside the other foot, a tiny motion accent
